reviews.title: Don’t question it, get this one
reviews.comment: An excellent board, Gigabyte brand has been my go to for computer builds since I purchased my first one in 2004. Great functionality, easy to install, looks nice and a wide range of compatible hardware. I highly recommend the brand and this board has proved to be great for my latest gaming rig!
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Trusted Brand, Great Options.
reviews.comment: Great Board, easy OS install, firmware menu is easy.  Quick to toss in the parts and then mount in a box.  This is like the 3rd PC I've built with a Gigabyte base.  Highly Recommend.
reviews.author: Edster

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.comment: Wont boot up. PSU tested good. After connect the 24pin and cpu power cable, and CPU_FAN, no lights on mobo. but after i took off all the DIMMs, orange light on. Did DIMM swap test on each slot, power drained, COMS cleaned many times. Tried jump start, also no respons, no nothing. Suspecting mobo DOA.  this mobo didn't come with anytype of factory seal. The second day I got another named brand mobo, also minimum start test with CPU_FAN, instantly successfully boot up.
reviews.author: Kent Z

reviews.title: So far, so good!
reviews.comment: So far, so good. I haven't had any problems with this motherboard. I did update the bios, as the one it shipped with was quite old. The processor I put in it was a core 7 ultra 265k.
reviews.author: Monny

reviews.title: GB=Dollar Store PC Parts // Spend a bit more for real brand (MSI, Asus, etc)
reviews.comment: Died after 1 month. Bought a B series from MSI and its been working like a CHARM. Id been warned about GB in the passed but I needed a decent deal building for my grandpa. I had to build it twice thanks to Gigabyte.
reviews.author: Brandon Bieber
